name: RedisStore
label: Redis Store
def: Store and retrieve data from Redis
description: Persistent key-value storage with TTL, lists, and hash support

options.label: Delete
options.description: Delete a key from Redis

options.label: Get
options.description: Get the value of a key from Redis

options.label: Increment
options.description: Atomically increments a key by 1. Creates the key if it does not exist

options.label: Info
options.description: Returns generic information about the Redis instance

options.label: Keys
options.description: Returns all the keys matching a pattern

options.label: Pop
options.description: Pop data from a redis list

options.label: Publish
options.description: Publish message to redis channel

options.label: Push
options.description: Push data to a redis list

options.label: Set
options.description: Set the value of a key in redis

options.label: Set Add (SADD)
options.description: Add one or more members to a set

options.label: Set Remove (SREM)
options.description: Remove one or more members from a set

options.label: Set Members (SMEMBERS)
options.description: Get all members of a set

options.label: Set Is Member (SISMEMBER)
options.description: Check if a member exists in a set

options.label: Set Size (SCARD)
options.description: Get the number of members in a set

options.label: Set Intersection (SINTER)
options.description: Return the intersection of multiple sets

options.label: Set Union (SUNION)
options.description: Return the union of multiple sets

options.label: Set Difference (SDIFF)
options.description: Return the difference between the first set and other sets

options.label: Hash Keys (HKEYS)
options.description: Get all field names in a hash

options.label: Hash Values (HVALS)
options.description: Get all values in a hash

options.label: Hash Exists (HEXISTS)
options.description: Check if a field exists in a hash

options.label: Hash Increment (HINCRBY)
options.description: Increment a hash field by a number

options.label: List Range (LRANGE)
options.description: Get a slice of list elements by range

options.label: List Length (LLEN)
options.description: Get the length of a list

options.label: List Index (LINDEX)
options.description: Get element at specific index

options.label: List Set (LSET)
options.description: Set value at specific index

options.label: List Trim (LTRIM)
options.description: Trim list to specified range

options.label: Sorted Set Add (ZADD)
options.description: Add members with scores to a sorted set

options.label: Sorted Set Range (ZRANGE)
options.description: Get members by rank with optional scores

options.label: Sorted Set Score (ZSCORE)
options.description: Get the score of a member

options.label: Sorted Set Count (ZCOUNT)
options.description: Count members in a score range

options.label: Sorted Set Increment (ZINCRBY)
options.description: Increment a member's score by a value

options.label: Sorted Set Remove (ZREM)
options.description: Remove one or more members from a sorted set

options.label: Automatic
options.description: Tries to figure out the type automatically depending on the data

options.label: Hash
options.description: Data in key is of type 'hash'

options.label: List
options.description: Data in key is of type 'lists'

options.label: Sets
options.description: Data in key is of type 'sets'

options.label: String
options.description: Data in key is of type 'string'

fields.label: Pattern
fields.description: Pattern to match keys (supports * and ? wildcards)

fields.label: Members
fields.description: Comma-separated values or array from previous node

fields.label: Other Set Keys
fields.description: Additional set keys for intersection/union/difference operations

fields.label: Increment By
fields.description: Integer value to increment the hash field by (can be negative)

fields.label: Start Index
fields.description: Starting position (0-based, negative counts from end)

fields.label: Index
fields.description: List position (0-based, negative counts from end)

fields.label: TTL (seconds)
fields.description: Time to live in seconds (0 = no expiry)

fields.label: Score
fields.description: Score value for sorting (can be integer or float)

fields.label: Score-Member Pairs
fields.description: Comma-separated score:member pairs for batch add

fields.label: Reverse Order (High to Low)
fields.description: Return results from highest to lowest score

fields.label: Min Score
fields.description: Minimum score (use -inf for no lower bound)

fields.label: Max Score
fields.description: Maximum score (use +inf for no upper bound)
